description.value:
You learn the following new ways to use your Sneak Attack:

  • Envenom (Cost: 3d6). The target must succeed on a Constitution Saving Throw or become Poisoned for 1 minute. It can repeat the Saving Throw at the end of every one of its turns, ending the effect on a success. You must have a Poisoner's Kit on your person to use this effect. Alternatively, you can apply a poison that you currently have on your person. If you do so, the save DC of the poison changes to your Cunning Strike save DC if it is normally lower.
  • Silence (Cost: 1d6). The target must succeed on a Dexterity Saving Throw or be unable to speak or produce sound with its voice until the end of your next turn.
